scope: End-to-end load of prepared container files from local disk followed by horizon.codec.decode, per method. Timed read includes open, read, close and, for os_cache_bypass, the volume geometry query, aligned buffer allocation, copy to bytes and buffer release. warm_buffered: each measured read is preceded by an unmeasured complete ordinary read of the same file, so the OS file cache is expected to be present. os_cache_bypass: the reading handle is opened with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING, bypassing the Windows file data cache for that read; this is NOT a physically cold device read (SSD/controller/drive caches are not evicted, no global cache purge is performed, and physical read counters were not verified).

settings.timer: time.perf_counter_ns: before reader, after reader, after decode; total_ns = read_ns + decode_ns; validation after final timer
settings.p95_policy: numpy.percentile(method=linear) and numpy.median over all raw samples; total/read/decode summarized independently, never summed; no min-of-runs

order.cases: sequential in --input order; each case fully benchmarked before the next
order.warmups: 2 unmeasured complete measure_once calls per mode+method per case, in MODES x METHODS order, before timed repetitions
order.method_order: per repetition r: zstd,delta_zstd when r is even, reversed when odd
order.mode_order: blocks of 2 repetitions: warm_buffered,os_cache_bypass when (r // 2) is even, reversed when odd
order.nesting: within a repetition: for each mode in mode order, for each method in method order, one measured call

settings.caching_policy: containers written once to a new --containers-dir with fsync, kept for audit; no in-process data cache; every measured call reads the file anew and discards bytes and decoded array after validation; only source arrays are retained for validation

warm_buffered.api: Python open(rb) buffered read of at most MAX_FILE_BYTES+1 bytes
warm_buffered.priming: complete unmeasured ordinary read immediately before each measured read

os_cache_bypass.api: CreateFileW, GetFileSizeEx, VirtualAlloc, one synchronous ReadFile, VirtualFree(MEM_RELEASE), CloseHandle
os_cache_bypass.alignment_policy: max(4096, bytes_per_sector) from GetDiskFreeSpaceW on the GetVolumePathNameW root, queried per call inside the read timing; request rounded up to alignment; buffer from VirtualAlloc (allocation-granularity aligned, verified per call)
os_cache_bypass.eof_policy: ReadFile byte count must equal GetFileSizeEx size from the same handle; file on disk is never padded or modified
os_cache_bypass.limitations: bypasses only the Windows file data cache for the reading handle; device and controller caches are not evicted; physical read counters and disk model were not queried or verified
